rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for doing something in an environmentally friendly way.

example.english: We deal with food waste environmentally, so we do not have to keep sending it to landfills.
example.traditional: 我哋環保咁處理廚餘，唔使成日拎去堆填區。
